purpose: Test whether separately observed functional parts teach one reusable correspondence for unobserved finite combinations
scope: Matched target parameters, natural contexts, steps and single-part normalization; compare three singleton-part teachers with mixed requests. Frozen source and target dictionaries share the same model and training corpus.
statistics_unit: Sentence pairs jointly resampled within grammatical paradigm, preserving all requests and fixed target seeds
threshold_source_split: Original R26 source-only definitions; no outcome-based request or context selection
primary_endpoint: Mean across fixed grammars of source-effect-normalized finite response RMSE on four binary combinations absent from singleton training. Fractional strengths, grammatical accuracy, response-sign agreement and same-information source-additive prediction reported separately.
budget: Complete question budget 9000 driver seconds, 12GiB CUDA and 6GiB new run assets across smoke, development and justified frozen confirmation. All teacher observations, repeats and evaluation calls counted.
